Select molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno. Join assays on assay_id. Join target_dictionary on tid. Join docs on assays.doc_id. Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno. Join compound_records on activities.record_id. Filter by target CHEMBL4822, standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and require canonical_smiles not null and (pubmed_id not null or doi not null). Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
